made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/quiosco-sheet-make.js, from quiosco-set.html (window.QUIOSCO.E) and the design of El quiosco (the orchestrator's p6-spec, section quiosco). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 122. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is turned 45 degrees: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera); the set's PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 122 + 13 v - 22.5 z. The front counter runs across the picture at v -0.5 to 0 (the vendedor stands behind it, in the booth); the two wings come towards the camera at u -1.75 and 1.75
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the ground; z 0.68: a stool's seat; 0.42: a chair's; 0.72: the table's top; 1.05: the counter's and the wings' top) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 53 rows drawn standing for a grown-up, 41 for a child; the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); abuela sitting mkAbuelaS (52 x 50): column 17 (her middle) and row 36 (her lap) on (sx, sy), the spot being the seat; a child or a grown-up sitting (mkPersona with sent = 1; the stool, the chair): column 24 and the lap row, the bottom of the hips: row 16 + 2 t + 3 (t 7 a child: 33; t 11 a grown-up: 41) on (sx, sy), the spot being the seat's top. The sitting drawing is the front view: whoever sits on a stool faces right (stools 1 and 2) or left (3 and 4) in the game; the sheet says it (spots.*.face), the stand-in does not turn. A small thing: its bottom middle on the point
rules.view: the view has a zoom (here 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture) and x0 = the window's left column. Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character
rules.box: a person's box is its width (the frog 32, a grown-up 24, a child 24, the dog 28) with the feet's spot in the middle; the rows come from the drawn sprite

The window's point is the ground point under its middle column at the picture's middle row

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the roof, its edge and the chains, the counter and the wings, the posts, the table, the trees hide whoever is behind them.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where bakedZ[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias (bakedZ: window.DEPTH.z of the set page). The same rule as El mostrador's and El cruce's sheets: the upright plane through the feet
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias; two planes within 0.001 are a tie and the later layer is drawn

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the ground (z 0). The spec gives no radius: these are El mostrador's and El cruce's (frog .45, grown-ups .35, children .28) (open point)
shadows.onSeat: whoever sits on a stool or a chair, stands on the table, the counter or a wing (z above 0) casts none: the seat is not ground (a shadow cast at the pavement under it would show in front of it)
